say: That's ten. We can get back to work.

broadcast: We're builders, not miners, and we've run out of tungsten. There's plenty in the ground if you've got a cutter, and I won't ask if you bought it instead. Ten units in the hopper and we're back to work.
_speech: A foreman with a small, practical stake and no patience for digging. 41a's voice as a stand-in; his ear decides.
